title: Copy/Paste Nodes (Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V)
description: Implement copy/paste functionality for selected nodes. When a user selects one or more nodes and presses Ctrl+C, then Ctrl+V, new nodes should be created with the same data but at a slightly offset position. This is a standard expectation in any node-based editor. Implementation: listen for keyboard events (Ctrl+C stores selected nodes in clipboard state, Ctrl+V creates duplicates with offset positions). Low effort since addNode already exists in graph-store, just need to clone existing node data with new IDs and offset positions.
